image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a stack of baby bibs. The primary subject is a pale pink fabric bib with a rounded shape, featuring embroidered floral patterns (yellow flowers, green leaves) and small butterfly motifs. It has a visible neck hole with pink piping/trim. Behind it are other bibs: one white with a printed design and a clear plastic pocket containing a card, and a dark brown polka-dotted bib at the bottom right with a green snap button.
